resources.string:
Particles appear and a ring closes in on each one. Tap it at the exact moment the ring lands on its core: a perfect or good hit scores points and builds your combo, while tapping too early breaks it.

You have three lives. Missing a particle costs one, and so does touching the pink antimatter, so let it fade away by itself. Tapping empty space only breaks your combo.

As time passes, new kinds join in: the green electron moves around, the yellow nucleus needs two taps, and the purple chain must be tapped in numbered order.

Your combo multiplies your points up to ×4 and gives a life back every 50. Good hits fill the gauge at the bottom, and when it is full you overheat: double points for 8 seconds. Every 5,000 points earns a neutrino.

Touch and drag to slide the paddle, and let go to launch the particle. Bounce it to break every brick and clear the level. If it falls off the bottom you lose a life, and you start with three.

Chained hits build a combo that multiplies your score. Some bricks drop bonuses to catch with the paddle: wider paddle, lasers, extra balls, shield, fire and more. Coins drop too.

After each level, pick one of three relics for the rest of the run. Every fifth level is a boss, followed by a shop where you can spend your coins on permanent upgrades.

If you go about a minute without breaking anything, your finger can break a brick by touching it, once every 5 seconds.

The electron circles the nucleus on its own. Tap anywhere to reverse its direction.

Asteroids fall toward the nucleus: if one hits the electron, it is over. Every asteroid swallowed by the nucleus scores a point.

Sweep up the green energy quanta on the orbit to score more. Catching them in a row builds a combo, but a quantum that fades away breaks it.

The longer you survive, the faster everything gets. You earn one neutrino for every 15 seconds you last.

Use your left thumb to move and your right thumb to aim a stream of photons. It pushes atoms around without destroying them.

Push two identical atoms together to fuse them into the next element: hydrogen into helium, then carbon, and so on up to iron, which goes supernova and clears the screen. Clear every atom to finish the wave.

Touching an atom hurts, so keep your distance. Watch for cosmic rays (step out of the dotted line), free neutrons that split heavy nuclei, and antimatter that explodes. Every fifth wave, a black hole appears: push atoms into it until it bursts, and tap fast to break free if it catches you.

Stardust you collect buys upgrades in the constellations menu. You earn 2 neutrinos per wave cleared.

Drag your finger to move your probe, which fires on its own. Dodge enemy shots and destroy every enemy to clear the wave. You have a few hit points, and the run ends when they are all gone.

After each wave, choose a module to improve your probe. Every fifth wave is a boss. Now and then, a field of ice fragments asks you to dodge them with your weapons off, for extra modules.

Once you own them, use the two buttons at the bottom: the magnetic field deflects nearby shots, and the nova pulse clears them. You can also use a second finger for the magnet and a double tap for the nova.

Hold the buttons at the bottom to ride: throttle and brake on the right, lean back and lean forward on the left. Use the lean buttons to balance in the air and land on your wheels.

Follow the track and cross each checkpoint flag on your wheels. If you crash, tap the screen or the round arrow to restart from the last checkpoint. Hold that arrow to restart the whole track.

Reach the finish line to complete the track, then tap for a new one, or use the other button at the top. Your time and number of crashes are shown.

You earn one neutrino for every 500 m of new distance.

Swipe left or right to change lane, up to jump and down to slide. The four buttons at the bottom do the same.

Jump over amber hurdles, slide under pink gates and drones, and change lane to avoid containers. A hit makes you stumble, and a second one soon after ends the run. Atoms and clean passes build a chain that multiplies your score.

Collect the shield, the magnet and the overdrive to help you. Three missions are always running: complete them all to rank up and unlock new suits. You earn neutrinos according to the distance you run.

Pause to bank your run before leaving.

You run inside a tunnel that scrolls toward you. Swipe left or right to rotate it and move to another face.

When a ring reaches you, you must be on a solid face. If you are over a gap, the run is over, so look ahead and change face in time.

Your score is how long you survive, and the tunnel speeds up as you go. Choose a hexagon or an octagon before starting. You earn one neutrino for every 15 seconds.

Your ball rides an endless rolling landscape. Hold your finger down to pull it hard toward the ground, and release to let it fly.

Tap while going downhill to get a speed boost. Release on a climb to soar into the air, or to hop when you are slow.

There is no game over: just go as far, as fast and as high as you can. Distance, speed and altitude are shown at the top. Use the color button to change the look and the round arrow to start again.

Tap anywhere to make the cat jump, even in mid-air, and keep tapping to stay up.

Pass between the birds and the poles. Each obstacle you pass scores a point. Touching a bird, a pole or a wire, or hitting the ground, costs a heart. You have three hearts, and a short moment of protection after each hit.

The cat flies faster and faster, up to double speed after ten minutes. Pause with the button at the top.

Touch below the potato, pull back like a slingshot and release: it flies the other way, harder the further you pull. A simple tap makes it bounce straight up.

The hot plate cooks it, faster when it is close and twice as fast over the glowing spots. Send it out through a side of the screen when it is in the green zone of its ring: that scores 100 points.

Catch falling toppings with it for +50% points each. A potato that leaves too raw or too burnt, or burns on the plate, is a strike. Three strikes end the game.

More potatoes join in as time passes.

Slide your finger to place the body at the top of the jar and release to drop it. When two identical bodies touch, they merge into the next one, from dust all the way to the black hole.

Merging in a quick row builds a chain that multiplies your points. Two blue giants collapse into a black hole, which is smaller, and two black holes annihilate each other for a big bonus.

If bodies stay piled above the rim for too long, the jar overflows and the game ends. Your game is saved when you leave. You earn one neutrino for every 150 points.
